name: Spark of Freedom
summary: A fire elemental’s display ends with the creature exhausted. Its attention had been fixed on the Dark Irons, and the others are relieved it did not turn on them.

sections.title: After the Flames
sections.body: The onlooker marvels at the display and is glad the fire elemental ran out of strength. The Dark Irons had drawn its attention; the rest of the group could have been in danger if it had turned on them.

faq.q: What happened to the fire elemental?
faq.answer: The fire elemental ran out of strength after a pyrotechnic display.

faq.q: Who was the elemental going after?
faq.answer: The fire elemental had been going after the Dark Irons.
The onlooker is glad the elemental did not turn on the rest of the group.

attribution: In-game quest text: Spark of Freedom
